StartLux Labs' released StartLux-Decision-v1.1-9B-Instant (at 18a17f7), a fine-tune of Qwen3.5-9B that reads the prompt bidirectionally and also reads images. It ran on our hardware (one DGX Spark), one request at a time, through the server of its package (startlux-decide serve --launch-vllm, StartLux-Decision at a99977d) on vLLM 0.31.0, with vision on, as its 4B sibling. Its weights are licensed for non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 4.0); we use them non-commercially, for evaluation. Its card lists English only.

Request time: the time at least one request was in flight, over the requests whose answers were kept.
